name: EPINEPHRINE
indications_original: Epinephrine is a non-selective alpha and beta adrenergic agonist indicated: • For emergency treatment of allergic reactions (Type 1), including anaphylaxis, in adults and pediatric patients. ( 1.1 ) • To increase mean arterial blood pressure in adult patients with hypotension associated with septic shock. ( 1.2 )
contraindications_original: • Anaphylaxis ( 2.2 ) : • Administer intramuscularly or subcutaneously into anterolateral thigh every 5 to10 minutes as needed. • Adults and pediatric patients 30 kg or greater: 0.3 mg to 0.5 mg (0.3 mL to 0.5 mL) • Pediatric patients under 30 kg: 0.01 mg/kg (0.01 mL/kg) • Hypotension associated with septic shock ( 2.3 ): • Dilute epinephrine in dextrose solution prior to infusion. • Infuse epinephrine into a large vein. • Titrate 0.05 mcg/kg/min to 2 mcg/kg/min to achieve desired blood pressure. • Wean gradually.
warningsAndPrecautions_original:
Epinephrine Injection is supplied as a clear, colorless solution as follows: 
                  Each carton contains 1 multiple dose vial containing 30 mg/30 mL (1 mg/mL) epinephrine injection, USP in an amber glass vial 
                  NDC 72572-238-01      30 mL Multiple Dose Vial 
                  Epinephrine is light sensitive. Protect from light until ready to use. 
                  Do not refrigerate. Protect from freezing. 
                  Vial and contents must be discarded 30 days after initial use. 
                  Store at room temperature, between 20°C to 25°C (68°F to 77°F). (See USP Controlled Room Temperature.) Protect from alkalis and oxidizing agents. 
                  The container closure is not made with natural rubber latex.
